text:
rachel_eval: quick flag from luma-v1 int8 bring-up — hitting a reproducible "interscript gap glue" where spacing between Arabic/CJK or emoji+CJK collapses in generated text. zh+ar->en BLEU -2.4 vs fp16 on loc-mix-800. sample below.

yun_onboard: can you paste the run config + input/output example?

rachel_eval: run id 2026-07-12-luma-int8-gap, model: luma-v1, quant=int8 per-channel asymmetric, kernels=auto, tokenizer v2026-06-20. evalset: loc-mix-800 (800 pairs). example:
```
input: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u3000\u6e2c\u8a66"  // Arabic + IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE + CJK
fp16 output: "Hello test"
int8 output: "Hellotest"
// fused boundary after ideographic space -> missing token boundary in detok
```

omar_infra: yikes. did tokenizer.roundtrip on the input? any token-id mismatches or normalization differences?

rachel_eval: roundtrip ok, token ids identical. issue only appears in generation/detok. reproduced on both GPU and CPU shards. also saw similar behavior when emoji is adjacent to han: "😀\u6E2C" -> fp16: "😀 test" vs int8: "😀test".

tara_research: this smells like tiny logit shifts around short-prefix subtokens (1-2 subtokens) caused by accumulation/kv quant paths. quick check: try forcing fp16 for accumulation and KV (env flags RT_ACCUM_FP16=true RT_KV_FP16=true) to see if it matches fp16 baseline.

rachel_eval: ran with both flags on same shard. BLEU recovered to -0.6 delta and the sample detok matched fp16. p50 latency +10ms.

yun_onboard: good signal. can you dump kv tensors + per-token logits for failing sample (int8 and fp16-kv) and attach to an issue? I'll triage kernel selection heuristics if we have tensors.

rachel_eval: uploaded artifacts to https://redwood.internal/issue/LUMA-INT8-233 (kv dumps, logits, detok logs) and added a tiny fuzz harness that injects ideographic spaces, emoji boundaries, and invisible-joiners next to CJK for CI.

omar_infra: until kernel fix we should add a temporary Optimize/Recommend rule: when dataset locale includes mixed scripts (e.g., contains both CJK and RTL or emoji), recommend "kv_fp16=true" and "preserve_invisible_joins=true". I'll draft the change and add an opt-out flag for Dedicated customers.

tara_research: follow-ups: 1) try int8 with RT_ACCUM_FP16 only vs RT_KV_FP16 only to isolate accumulation vs kv contribution; 2) experiment with soft pretokenizer that inserts ZWSP between ambiguous boundaries as a mitigation; 3) run a narrow quant clip variant to see if scale buckets reduce boundary drift.

ci-bot: CI job started for LUMA-INT8-233 on eng-ml/luma-v1-int8 (#4311). builders: x4. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4311

yun_onboard: also saw a couple of mirrored-bracket oddities on mixed-orient inputs in the same run — collecting those samples into the ticket.

rachel_eval: thanks all. keeping the int8 canary paused for localization slices until kernel + detok mitigations land. PR with fuzz cases is up. :white_check_mark:
